_comment: Empty greenhouse plant model — bare floor + glazing only, no crops. c_eff_mj_per_c is the air-coupled effective heat capacity (air + soil surface + structure) in MJ/degC; it sets the thermal-lag time constant via tau_T = c_eff / (ACH * V * rho * cp). 10 MJ/degC ≈ ~3.5× air mass: typical for an empty greenhouse without active soil or crop biomass.
